# Interoperability fixtures

`rust_sdk_interop.sbox.b64` is a single-object SBOX 3.1 Bundle generated by `sdk/rust/examples/encrypt_file.rs` from:

- `sdk/rust/tests/fixtures/public_identity.json`
- `sdk/rust/tests/fixtures/rust-sdk-interop.txt`

`test/app/rust_sdk_interop_test.dart` derives the matching private identity from the frozen Profile 1 mnemonic, authenticates Metadata, and fully decrypts this Rust-generated object. The fixture is Base64 text so it remains reviewable and portable across repository tooling; it decodes to a 17,164-byte `.sbox` object.

To regenerate it, run the Rust example into a temporary directory, Base64-encode the resulting object without line wrapping, replace `rust_sdk_interop.sbox.b64`, and run both the Rust SDK tests and the Dart interoperability test.
